subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a spelling error.

In all instances of frustrasion, / you will always find / the anger directed towards / a single person only.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"frustrasion"** is a misspelling of the correct word** "frustration"**. **"Frustration"** means the feeling of being upset or annoyed as a result of being unable to change or achieve something. (निराशा)

 
 
• **Example: **She couldn't hide her **frustration** when the project was delayed again.
 
 
 
• The correct word is **"frustration"**. (निराशा)
 
 
• **Example: **His frustration was evident when the computer crashed just before he saved his work.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: *** 'In all instances of frustration'.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **you will always find** (आप हमेशा पाएंगे): This segment is correct and means that something will be consistently discovered or observed.

 
 
• **Example:** You will always find her reading a book in her free time.
 
 
 
• **the anger directed towards** (गुस्सा निर्देशित होता है): This segment is correct and means that anger is aimed at or focused on someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** The anger directed towards him was understandable given his actions.
 
 
 
• **a single person only** (केवल एक व्यक्ति): This segment is correct and means that something is limited to one individual.
 
 
• **Example:** The blame was placed on a single person only, even though it was a team effort.
